paite: Huai thilte nung in Pathian in Abraham a-enchian hi. Akiang ah, "Abraham," achi a; ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
heading: Isak Lan Ding In Pathian In Abraham Thu Apia
english: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na tapa, na tapa neihsun, na ittak, Isak tonpih inla, Moriah gam ah pai in, huai ah ka hon hilh ding tang khat ah halmang thillat in amah lan in," achi hi.
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

paite: Beltak in Abraham athou a, sabiltung abawl a, akiang ah atapa Isak toh sikha tangval nih atonpih hi. Haltum thillat a ding in sing a-ek a, athou a, Pathian in ahilhna mun lam ah apaita hi.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

paite: Ani thum ni in Abraham adak a, amun gamlapi a om amu hi.
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

paite: Abraham in asikha tangvalte kiang ah, "Hiai ah sabiltung toh ana om un. Kei leh naupang huai pam ah ka va hoh ding ua; huai ah Pathian ka va be ding ua; na kiang uah ka hong kik nawn ding uh," achi hi.
english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

paite: Abraham in halmang thillatna ding sing ala a, atapa Isak aposak hi. Ama'n mei leh temta atawi a; anih un apaikhawm uhi.
english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

paite: Isak in apa Abraham ahoupih a, "Pa," achi a, ama'n, "Bawi, hiai ah ka om,” achi hi. Ama'n, "En dih, mei leh sing a-om a; hileh leng halmang thillat ding belamnou lah koi ah?" achi hi.
english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

paite: Abraham in, "Bawi, Pathian in amah a dia halmang thillat ding belamnou angaihtuah tawm ding hi," achi a; anih un apaikhawm zel uhi.
english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

paite: Pathian in ahilhna mun ava tungta ua, Abraham in huai ah maitam adoh a, sing chiangkhawm in, atapa Isak ahen a, maitam a sing tung ah alumsak hi.
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

paite: Abraham in akhut alik a, atapa thahna ding temta ala hi.
english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

paite: TOUPA angel in van a kipan amah asam a, "Abraham, Abraham," achi a, ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Naupang tung ah na khut kha ke'n. Amah bangmah loh ke'n. Na tapa, na neihsun mahmah leng kei a dia na it louh ziak in Pathian na lau chih tu in ka theita," achi hi.
english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

paite: Abraham adak a, a-en a, ngai in, anunglam ah belampa, singbawk a akii awk ana om hi. Abraham in huai belampa ava man a, atapa sik in halmang thillat in alan zawta hi.
english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

paite: Abraham in huai mun min, "Jehovah Jireh," asa hi; tuni tan a, "TOUPA tang ah ngaihtuah hi na ve," achih zel bang un.
english: Abraham called the name of that place “Yahweh Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”

paite: TOUPA angel in anihveina ding in van a kipan Abraham asam nawn hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

paite: "Hiai thil na hih ziak leh na tapa neihsun na it louh ziak in kei mahmah in ka kichiam hi.
english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says Yahweh, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

paite: K'on vualzawl ngeingei ding a, van a aksite zah leh tuipi piau a piaunel zah in na suante ka pungsak ngeingei ding. Na suante'n adoute uh kulh kongkhak atang ding uhi.
english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

paite: Ka thu na man ziak in na suan ah leitung a nam chih vualzawl in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

paite: Asikha tangvalte kiang ah Abraham akik nawn a, athou ua, Beer-sheba lam manoh in apai uhi. Beer-sheba ah Abraham ateng hi.
english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

paite: Hichi in huai thilte nung in Abraham kiang ah, "Ngai in, Milkah in leng na sanggampa Nahor tate aneihsakta ve," chi in Abraham ahilh uhi.
heading: Nahor Suante
english: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

paite: Ata masa Huz ahi a; asanggampa Buz ahi, Aram pa Kemuel;
english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

paite: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph leh Bethuelte leng ahi uh,
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

paite: Bethuel in tanu Rebekah anei a; huai giatte Milkah in Abraham nau Nahor aneihsakte ahi uh.
english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

paite: Amei, amin Reumah in leng Tebah, Gaham, Thahash leh Maakah anei hi.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
